Game Overview

Pet Drive In puts players into a animal experience centered on serve adorable, hungry pets in a fast-paced drive-through. Race against the clock to craft perfect, custom orders using the right ingredients. Test your speed and accuracy as you keep the furry customers happy and your cash register ringing. Can you handle the pressure of Pet Drive In?
